sentences.text: No: for all new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after October 1, 2024, a UCB cannot charge any fees, charges, etc. not mentioned in the KFS at any stage during the term of the loan without explicit consent of the borrower.

The KFS is the standardised statement of the key terms of a loan, including the annual percentage rate (APR), the fees and charges and the repayment schedule, provided to the borrower before execution of the loan contract.
For this case, the bank is Example UCB (fictional) · Tier 3 UCB and the sanction date is 2026-02-10, so the cited UCB rule applies.
